## Round 1: Cognitive and Technical Assessment

The first round involved a cognitive and technical assessment designed to evaluate problem-solving skills, technical knowledge, and logical reasoning. Clearing this stage was essential to progress further in the selection process.

## Round 2: Group Discussion

The second round was a group discussion on the topic, "Pros and Cons of AI." This session tested communication skills, critical thinking, and the ability to articulate viewpoints effectively while interacting with other participants.

## Round 3: Interviews

This stage consisted of three separate interviews, each assessing different skill sets and attributes.

### a. Technical Interview

As I had chosen visualization as my skill preference, this interview focused on related areas:

* Power BI: I was asked scenario-based questions involving Power BI implementation. A situation with specific requirements was presented, and I had to explain which parameters to use.
* General Questions:
  + "Why HCL?"
  + "What do you know about Generative AI?"
  + Leadership-related questions (based on my resume).

### b. Tech HR Interview

This interview centered on:

* Technical Skills: Questions about the skills listed in my resume.
* Project Discussion: Detailed conversations about the projects I had worked on.
